headline: Appulse launches November 26 on Steam
title: Appulse | Pinball Roguelite Shooter Nov 26 | Gaming News
video_script: Appulse launches on Steam on November twenty sixth, twenty twenty six. It mixes pinball with a roguelite shooter: you use flippers and your weapon's recoil to move around, build upgrades, and climb leaderboards. Raw Fury is the publisher and the developer is Le Rado. A demo is available now. Pinball or shooter, which side wins for you? Comment below!
description: Appulse, a pinball and roguelite shooter from Le Rado and publisher Raw Fury, launches on Steam on November 26, 2026. Sources: Gematsu, Raw Fury, The Sixth Axis.
joke: Finally, a game where bouncing off walls counts as a strategy.
